Name: Quality of Life Complaint
Definitions: Ongoing neighborhood conditions that affect daily life, such as sidewalk obstruction, garbage, restroom locations or sanitation. Use a more specific Quality of Life Complaint type when one fits.

Name: Quality of Life Complaint - Broken Streetlights
Definitions: Streetlights that are out, flickering, damaged or missing, including requests for new lighting on a block.

Name: Quality of Life Complaint - Potholes
Definitions: Potholes, cave-ins and damaged road surface. Use Transportation Request instead for street redesign or repaving plans.

Name: Quality of Life Complaint - Ponding or Flooding
Definitions: Standing water, street flooding and poor drainage after rain. Use Clogged Catch Basins when a blocked drain is named as the cause.

Name: Quality of Life Complaint - Clogged Catch Basins
Definitions: Storm drains and catch basins that are blocked, clogged or need cleaning.

Name: Quality of Life Complaint - Illegal Parking
Definitions: Illegal, double, blocked-hydrant, bike-lane or abandoned-vehicle parking, and requests for parking enforcement.

Name: Quality of Life Complaint - Noise from Commercial Establishments
Definitions: Noise from bars, restaurants, clubs, construction and other businesses. Use License - Liquor License for a liquor license hearing about the same business.

Name: Quality of Life Complaint - Noise from Residents
Definitions: Noise from homes, apartments and neighbors, including parties and music.

Name: Quality of Life Complaint - Tree Pruning
Definitions: Requests to prune, remove, plant or inspect street trees.

Name: Quality of Life Complaint - Gas or Hot-Water Shutoffs
Definitions: Gas, heat or hot-water shutoffs in homes and buildings, including emergency shutoffs.

Name: Public Safety Issue
Definitions: Crime, drug activity, policing, or hazards to personal safety, such as dark areas in a park. Use this when the underlying problem is safety, even if the response is enforcement.

Name: Public Safety Issue - NYPD Community Engagement
Definitions: Requests for NYPD presence at community events and meetings, precinct updates, and community council or officer outreach.

Name: License - Liquor License
Definitions: Anything involving the State Liquor Authority, including new applications, renewals, stipulations, resolution corrections, and SLA hearings.
